decisive_items: vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion
submucosal mass on the lesser curvature of the stomach
low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
response.rationale: R2 uniquely captures the peripheral-to-central vascular signal, a hallmark of GIST, and the large bleeding submucosal gastric mass fits GIST better than leiomyoma. R1 relies only on nonspecific submucosal and hypoechoic features and lacks the vascular and bleeding correlates.

rejected.why: Leiomyoma is less likely because its raw support lacks the peripheral-to-central vascular signal and the bleeding/anemia presentation, which are more characteristic of GIST.
